'import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = dataset.copy()
df.columns = [str(column) for column in df.columns]

bucket_field = "Drink Bucket"
imputed_field = "Next Day Has Imputed Values"
metric_fields = [
    "Next Day Sleep Hours",
    "Next Day Deep Sleep Hours",
    "Next Day REM Sleep Hours",
    "Next Day HRV",
    "Next Day Average HR",
    "Next Day Resting HR",
    "Next Day Wrist Temperature",
    "Next Day Blood Oxygen",
    "Next Day Active Energy",
    "Next Day Steps",
    "Next Day Workout Minutes",
]

label_map = {
    "Next Day Sleep Hours": "Sleep",
    "Next Day Deep Sleep Hours": "Deep Sleep",
    "Next Day REM Sleep Hours": "REM Sleep",
    "Next Day HRV": "HRV",
    "Next Day Average HR": "Average HR",
    "Next Day Resting HR": "Resting HR",
    "Next Day Wrist Temperature": "Wrist Temp",
    "Next Day Blood Oxygen": "Blood Oxygen",
    "Next Day Active Energy": "Active Energy",
    "Next Day Steps": "Steps",
    "Next Day Workout Minutes": "Workout Min",
}

required_fields = [bucket_field, imputed_field] + metric_fields
missing_fields = [field for field in required_fields if field not in df.columns]
if missing_fields:
    raise ValueError("Missing fields: " + ", ".join(missing_fields))

df[imputed_field] = pd.to_numeric(df[imputed_field], errors="coerce")
for field in metric_fields:
    df[field] = pd.to_numeric(df[field], errors="coerce")

df = df[df[bucket_field].notna()].copy()
df = df[df[bucket_field] != "Unknown"].copy()
df = df[df[imputed_field] == 0].copy()
df = df.dropna(subset=metric_fields, how="all").copy()

bucket_order = ["0 drinks", "1 drink", "2 drinks", "3+ drinks"]
df[bucket_field] = pd.Categorical(df[bucket_field], categories=bucket_order, ordered=True)
df = df.dropna(subset=[bucket_field])

group_means = df.groupby(bucket_field, observed=False)[metric_fields].mean().reindex(bucket_order)
group_counts = df.groupby(bucket_field, observed=False).size().reindex(bucket_order).fillna(0).astype(int)

if group_means.loc["0 drinks"].isna().all():
    raise ValueError("At least one usable 0-drink day is required for the baseline.")

baseline = group_means.loc["0 drinks"]
baseline_safe = baseline.replace(0, np.nan)
percent_change = group_means.sub(baseline, axis=1).div(baseline_safe.abs(), axis=1) * 100
raw_delta = group_means.sub(baseline, axis=1)
percent_change.loc["0 drinks"] = 0
raw_delta.loc["0 drinks"] = 0

heatmap_pct = percent_change.T
heatmap_delta = raw_delta.T
means_df = group_means.T
row_labels = [label_map[field] for field in heatmap_pct.index]
column_labels = [f"{bucket}\n(n={group_counts[bucket]})" for bucket in bucket_order]

values = heatmap_pct.values
finite_values = np.abs(values[np.isfinite(values)])
max_abs = finite_values.max() if finite_values.size else 0
color_limit = 10 if max_abs < 5 else min(40, np.ceil(max_abs / 5) * 5)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(15, 6.3))
image = ax.imshow(values, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-color_limit, vmax=color_limit, aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(column_labels)))
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(row_labels)))
ax.set_xticklabels(column_labels, fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticklabels(row_labels, fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Descriptive Next-Day Differences by Drink Count", fontsize=16, fontweight="bold", pad=14)

def format_mean(field, value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return ""
    if field in ["Next Day Steps", "Next Day Active Energy", "Next Day Workout Minutes"]:
        return f"{value:.0f}"
    if field in ["Next Day Blood Oxygen", "Next Day Wrist Temperature", "Next Day Average HR", "Next Day Resting HR", "Next Day HRV"]:
        return f"{value:.1f}"
    return f"{value:.2f}"

def format_delta(field, value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return "--"
    if field in ["Next Day Sleep Hours", "Next Day Deep Sleep Hours", "Next Day REM Sleep Hours"]:
        return f"{value:+.2f} h"
    if field == "Next Day HRV":
        return f"{value:+.1f} ms"
    if field in ["Next Day Average HR", "Next Day Resting HR"]:
        return f"{value:+.1f} bpm"
    if field == "Next Day Wrist Temperature":
        return f"{value:+.2f} F"
    if field == "Next Day Blood Oxygen":
        return f"{value:+.1f} pts"
    if field == "Next Day Active Energy":
        return f"{value:+.0f} kcal"
    if field == "Next Day Workout Minutes":
        return f"{value:+.0f} min"
    return f"{value:+.0f}"

for row_index, field in enumerate(heatmap_pct.index):
    for column_index, bucket in enumerate(bucket_order):
        pct = heatmap_pct.loc[field, bucket]
        delta = heatmap_delta.loc[field, bucket]
        mean_value = means_df.loc[field, bucket]
        if pd.isna(mean_value):
            text = "--"
            text_color = "black"
        elif bucket == "0 drinks":
            text = f"Baseline\n{format_mean(field, mean_value)}"
            text_color = "black"
        else:
            text = f"{format_delta(field, delta)}\n{format_mean(field, mean_value)}"
            text_color = "white" if pd.notna(pct) and abs(pct) >= color_limit * 0.45 else "black"
        ax.text(column_index, row_index, text, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8, fontweight="bold", color=text_color)

ax.set_xticks(np.arange(-0.5, len(column_labels), 1), minor=True)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(-0.5, len(row_labels), 1), minor=True)
ax.grid(which="minor", color="white", linewidth=1.4)
ax.tick_params(which="minor", bottom=False, left=False)
for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

colorbar = fig.colorbar(image, ax=ax, fraction=0.03, pad=0.025)
colorbar.set_label("Mathematical % change vs. 0-drink days", rotation=270, labelpad=18)
fig.text(
    0.5,
    0.015,
    "Compared with 0-drink days. Associations are descriptive and may reflect weekday, training, social, scheduling, and logging differences.\nColor shows mathematical increase or decrease, not universal good or bad.",
    ha="center",
    fontsize=8.5,
)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.075, 1, 1])
plt.show()'
